title: IT Support Technician (Part-Time, Remote)
description: Part-time remote IT Support Technician. Provide tier 1 support via phone, email and chat. Troubleshoot hardware, software and basic network issues. High school diploma required; CompTIA A+ or equivalent experience a plus. Entry-level candidates with strong customer-service skills encouraged to apply. Will train.

title: Remote Help Desk Technician - Tier 1 (No Experience)
description: Entry-level tier 1 help desk role. No prior experience required, training provided. Answer support tickets, reset passwords, guide customers through basic troubleshooting. High school diploma. Great customer-service attitude valued over credentials.

title: Remote Customer Support Associate
description: Help customers over chat and email. No degree required. We train you on our product. Ideal for someone with retail or food-service customer experience looking to move into tech. Strong communication a must.

title: Senior Systems Administrator
description: Senior systems administrator with 7+ years of experience managing Linux fleets, Kubernetes, and networking. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science required. Lead incident response and mentor junior staff.

title: Remote Technical Support Specialist - Entry Level
description: Entry-level technical support, no degree required. Provide friendly help to users, document tickets, escalate when needed. Willingness to learn matters most. Paid training provided.

title: Data Entry Clerk (Remote, Part-Time)
description: Part-time remote data entry. Accurate typing, attention to detail, basic computer skills. No experience necessary, high school diploma preferred.

title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description: Lead DevOps engineer, 10+ years experience, expert in AWS, Terraform, CI/CD. Master's degree preferred. Architect our cloud platform.

title: Junior Web Developer (HTML/CSS) - Remote
description: Junior web developer to build simple marketing pages. Beginner HTML and CSS is fine; we will mentor you. No degree required. Great first tech role for someone learning to code.

title: Remote IT Help Desk Associate
description: Help desk associate supporting clinic staff. 1 year of help desk experience preferred but not required for the right candidate. CompTIA A+ a plus. Reset accounts, triage tickets, escalate to tier 2. High school diploma.

title: Principal Security Architect
description: Principal security architect, 12+ years, CISSP required, bachelor's degree required. Own enterprise security strategy.

title: Remote Service Desk Analyst II
description: Level II Service Desk Analyst providing remote support to enterprise users. Support Citrix/VDI, Active Directory, Microsoft Office, and an ITSM ticketing system. Prioritize and escalate tickets, troubleshoot hardware and software. 2+ years of service desk experience preferred; no degree required. Google IT Support or CompTIA A+ a plus.

title: Remote IT Support Specialist (Level 2)
description: Level 2 IT Support Specialist for a remote-first MSP. Troubleshoot Windows and macOS, Active Directory account management, VPN, and networking issues. Handle escalations from tier 1 and document resolutions. 2-4 years IT support experience; certifications welcome but not required.

title: Remote Help Desk Analyst — Legal / iManage
description: Help desk analyst supporting attorneys and staff at a large law firm. Support iManage, Citrix/VDI, Microsoft Office, and document management systems. Strong customer service and ticket documentation. Prior legal-industry help desk experience a strong plus; no degree required.
